official_definition: Grand Ice Wall: Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue (Opposing Turn) When the opponent uses a Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue Magic card, before its effect activates, by exhausting this Nexus, immediately negate its effect.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Grand Ice Wall] or [Grand Ice Wall: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Grand Ice Wall]", "give [Grand Ice Wall]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
